title: Video Analysis Services
headline: Understand what changes.
intro: Video analysis is not simply image classification repeated many times. Time, motion, perspective and evidence continuity matter.
summary: The developing Alchemy perception portfolio looks toward motion analysis, object relations, pose and landmark providers, provider-neutral feature contracts and portable compute.

sections.heading: Sequence gives meaning
sections.body: A single frame can mislead. Temporal tracking and semantic relationships can help distinguish an observation from a conclusion about activity or intention.

sections.heading: Provider-neutral perception
sections.body: Pose, hand landmarks, facial mesh and comparable features should be served through separate library and service contracts. Provider implementations may vary, without rewriting the application around one SDK.

sections.heading: Compute where it belongs
sections.body: Media processing can be expensive. Job-to-node admission, compute placement and storage pins should let a task travel within an MI/MU mesh while its inputs, state and results remain durable.
